statement: (∀ (Q : ℕ) [NeZero Q] (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ Q) (s : ℂ), 0 < s.re → s.re < 1 → DirichletCharacter.LFunction χ s = 0 → s.re = 1 / 2) → ∀ (q : ℕ) [NeZero q] (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ q) (Z : Finset ℂ) (m : ℂ → ℕ) (u : ℝ), 1 ≤ u → (∀ s ∈ Z, 0 < s.re ∧ s.re < 1 ∧ χ.LFunction s = 0) → ‖∑ s ∈ Z, (m s : ℂ) * (u : ℂ)^s / s‖ ≤ Real.sqrt u * ∑ s ∈ Z, (m s : ℝ) / ‖s‖
